title: Weighted normalized curve shortening flow with applications in pseudo-Euclidean spaces
summary: The focus of this paper is the curve shortening flow for closed spacelike curves in pseudo-Euclidean spaces, which has very few results so far. Will they produce singularities where certain tangent line tends to light cone? If not, will such a curve shrink to a circular point? To answer these questions, we establish a dichotomy for planar weighted normalized curve shortening flow with uniformly positive and bounded weights.
